build_note: The first Dockerfile set PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH only after install, so browsers landed in /root/.cache/ms-playwright and chmod of /ms-playwright failed. That attempt did not start the server. The recipe was corrected before any Pilot #2 process, and this image is the corrected build.
build_recipe: npm ci --omit=dev --ignore-scripts && npx playwright-core install-deps chromium && npx playwright-core install chromium && apt-get install tini. Host npm was not used.
